# Commands

Every action the shell has, as of this build. `hogar-shell --list` prints the same table from the
binary you are running, and `man ./man/hogar-shell.1` is the manual form.

A request is a target, a command and its arguments. Replies begin with `ok` or `err`, and the exit
status mirrors that — see [Scripting](../guides/scripting.md).

## `shell`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ping` |  | check the shell is alive |
| `version` |  | the running build's version |
| `reload` |  | re-read config.toml and rebuild every surface |
| `status` |  | what the shell is holding: surfaces, threads and running services |
| `caches` |  | what the renderer's caches hold, per cache: bytes, entries and budget |
| `reclaim` |  | drop idle renderer caches and hand freed heap pages back to the kernel |
| `outputs` |  | list the compositor's monitors |
| `screens` |  | the compositor's monitors with mode, scale and make |
| `clients` |  | every open window: address, workspace, class and title |
| `dpms` | `<on\|off>` | switch every monitor's output on or off |
| `quit` |  | shut the shell down |

## `lock`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on` |  | lock the session |
| `off` |  | unlock the session |
| `toggle` |  | lock the session, or unlock it if it is locked |
| `status` |  | whether the session is locked, and whether this machine can lock at all |

## `idle`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` |  | whether the idle timers are armed, and what is holding them off |
| `inhibit` | `<on\|off\|toggle>` | hold the idle timers off by hand |

## `panel`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle` | `<module>` | open a module's panel, or close it if it is up |
| `open` | `<module>` | open a module's panel (idempotent) |
| `close` | `<module>` | close a module's panel |
| `list` |  | which panels are open right now |

## `launcher`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle` |  | open the application launcher, or close it if it is up |
| `close` |  | close the launcher |

## `audio`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sinks` |  | output devices: id, level, mute, and which is the default |
| `sources` |  | input devices: id, level, mute, and which is the default |
| `streams` |  | applications playing audio, with their own level |
| `default` | `<id>` | make a device the default sink or source |
| `set` | `<id> <percent>` | set one device's or application's level |
| `mute` | `<id>` | toggle one device's or application's mute |

## `dashboard`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle` |  | open the dashboard, or close it if it is up |
| `open` | `[tab]` | open the dashboard, optionally on a named page |
| `close` |  | close the dashboard |
| `tab` | `[dash\|media\|performance\|weather]` | read or switch the page the dashboard shows |

## `apps`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` |  | how many desktop entries are known |
| `reload` |  | re-scan the application directories |
| `search` | `<query>` | the launcher's ranking for a query, best first |

## `notifs`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clear` | `[app]` | drop one application's notifications, or the whole history |
| `mute` | `<app> [on\|off\|toggle]` | read or set whether an application's notifications may pop |
| `muted` |  | the applications whose notifications are muted |
| `dnd` | `<on\|off\|toggle>` | read or set do-not-disturb |
| `center` | `[open\|close\|toggle]` | the notification centre: history and quick toggles on a full-height surface |

## `screenshot`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `screen` |  | capture every monitor, composed into one image |
| `output` | `[name]` | capture one monitor, the focused one by default |
| `region` |  | pick a region with the pointer, then capture it |
| `cancel` |  | close the region picker without capturing |
| `last` |  | where the last capture went, or why it failed |

## `record`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `[screen\|output\|region]` | start recording; a region opens the picker first |
| `stop` |  | stop the recording, letting the encoder close its file |
| `toggle` |  | stop the recording, or start one of the whole screen |
| `pause` |  | suspend or resume the recording, on a backend that can |
| `status` |  | whether something is being recorded, for how long, and where |
| `list` |  | the recordings, newest first |

## `toast`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | `<text…>` | show an in-shell toast, for a script that wants to say something |
| `clear` |  | dismiss every toast on screen |

## `volume`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `get` |  | the default sink's level, and whether it is muted |
| `set` | `<percent>` | set the default sink's level |
| `step` | `<±percent>` | move the level by a delta |
| `up` |  | raise the level by [audio] increment |
| `down` |  | lower the level by [audio] increment |
| `mute` |  | toggle mute on the default sink |

## `mic`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `get` |  | the default source's level, and whether it is muted |
| `set` | `<percent>` | set the default source's level |
| `step` | `<±percent>` | move the source level by a delta |
| `up` |  | raise the source level by [audio] increment |
| `down` |  | lower the source level by [audio] increment |
| `mute` |  | toggle mute on the default source |

## `wifi`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` |  | the radio state, the network joined and its signal |
| `list` |  | networks in range: ssid, signal, security, saved |
| `radio` | `<on\|off\|toggle>` | switch the wireless radio |
| `scan` |  | look for networks now |
| `connect` | `<ssid> [password]` | join a network; the password is only needed the first time |
| `disconnect` |  | leave the current network, keeping it saved |
| `forget` | `<ssid>` | delete a saved network |

## `vpn`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` |  | every tunnel: id, state, kind and name |
| `up` | `<id>` | bring a tunnel up |

## `bluetooth`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` |  | the adapter's power, scan state and how many devices are connected |
| `devices` |  | every known device: path, state and name |
| `power` | `<on\|off\|toggle>` | switch the adapter on or off |
| `scan` | `<on\|off\|toggle>` | start or stop looking for devices (a scan stops itself) |
| `connect` | `<device-path>` | connect a device, pairing it first if it is new |
| `disconnect` | `<device-path>` | disconnect a device |
| `forget` | `<device-path>` | remove a pairing entirely |

| Command | Arguments | What it does |

| `play-pause` |  | toggle playback on the active player |
| `next` |  | skip to the next track |

| `shuffle` | `<on\|off\|toggle>` | set the shuffle state |
| `loop` | `<off\|track\|playlist\|cycle>` | set the repeat mode |

## `brightness`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `get` | `[output]` | the brightness of a screen (no output means the primary one) |
| `refresh` |  | detect displays again, for a monitor plugged in since startup |
| `list` |  | every controllable display: output, level, kind and label |
| `set` | `<percent> [output\|all]` | set the brightness of a screen (no output means the primary one) |
| `step` | `<±percent> [output\|all]` | move a screen's brightness by a delta |
| `up` | `[output\|all]` | raise the brightness by [brightness] increment |
| `down` | `[output\|all]` | lower the brightness by [brightness] increment |

## `nightlight`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on` | `[kelvin]` | warm every screen, 4000K by default |
| `off` |  | restore every screen's own colour |
| `toggle` | `[kelvin]` | turn the night light off if it is on, and on if it is not |

## `wallpaper`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `get` | `[output]` | the image a screen is showing (no output means the focused one) |
| `list` |  | every image in the library: folder, name and path |
| `reload` |  | re-scan the wallpaper folder |
| `set` | `<path> [output]` | put an image on every screen, or on one of them |
| `random` | `[output]` | pick one from the library at random |
| `clear` | `[output]` | drop the runtime choice, putting [background] back in charge |

## `scheme`

| Command | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` |  | the palette in use: theme, mode, variant and the wallpaper it came from |
| `colors` |  | every token of the palette now on screen, as name and hex |
| `list` |  | the palettes `scheme set` accepts |
| `set` | `<name>` | switch palette, `dynamic` for one built from the wallpaper |
| `mode` | `[dark\|light\|auto\|toggle]` | read or set the light/dark mode |
| `variant` | `[name]` | read or set how much colour a dynamic scheme carries |
| `refresh` |  | re-derive a dynamic palette from the current wallpaper |
| `export` |  | write the palette out for the rest of the desktop, ignoring [theme.export] enabled |
